description.value:
Learned to control the one thing about the mutation that's usually just a liability — venting stored radiation on purpose, in a burst, when it actually matters.

Effect — Once per day, release a short burst of radiation damage in melee reach; doing so worsens the Brittle drawback until your next rest.

rules.label: Vented a radiation burst since your last rest

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day radiation burst itself (damage amount, area, save DC) has no rule element: this schema's heritage records only carry passive modifiers, never a new activated-strike-style action, and no card anywhere states the burst's actual damage. Only the 'worsens Brittle until next rest' half is wired (Weakness physical raised to 2 while fractured-glass-vented is toggled on).
